name: Shoaib Yousaf
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: An English lightweight from Manchester Top Team (14-3, age 31), a former IMMAF world champion and veteran of Brave, ACB and Oktagon, on a six-fight winning streak. His last three wins were R1 knockouts, the latest over Tariel Abbasov at FCC 47 in September. He makes his UFC debut on a few days' notice.

how_they_fight.Striking: Eight knockouts in our data, all in R1.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped; all three losses are decisions.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Four decision wins; goes three rounds when needed.

keys_to_beat: Survive R1 and out-work him over three rounds

news.text: Signed with the UFC for a short-notice debut against John Mitchell.
